🚀 Live publishing (GitHub)

Once set up on this device, every change you make publishes itself to your live site. Only a device with your token can publish.

  1. Open github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new
  2. Repository access → Only select repositories → pick your site repo
  3. Permissions → Repository → Contents: Read and write
  4. Generate the token and paste it below
